scientific_integrity: Base example and its base entropy values attributed to Wu and Zhang; only new universal product lower bound and resulting product profile claimed. No independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Sharp lower bound requires a truly unrestricted full shift factor; arbitrary positive-entropy factors and exact product values for positive base h_G are not resolved. Historical priority remains provisional. Finite checker is supplementary, not infinite proof.
title: A sharp free-alphabet entropy floor for non-finite-type subshifts
